answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation escrow: every agent must lock a token deposit before it can trade or vote, like a lantern that only burns for those who paid for its oil. If an identity misbehaves or is proven a duplicate, peers slash its stake and publish the proof, leaving an echo on the ledger that warns others. A sybil attacker must therefore fund real value for each fake identity; planting a yarrow field of thousands of them costs proportionally more, turning cheap forgery into an expensive, traceable loss.
